label: ACCEPT
reason: All 49 members are module-level view variables built as extensions.get(View).as_view() (likes/, posting/, threads/, privatethreads/ urls.py), which makes views extendable by plugins via ExtensionRegistry.get in plugins/extensions.py. The only outlier is urlpatterns in core/testproject/urls.py, the test project's root URLconf (ROOT_URLCONF in tests) that composes misago.urls, so it is the one aggregator (one_off, R1). With nothing left to count, a new view variable written as bare View.as_view() is not caught by any tool: .ruff.toml selects only I and nothing type-checks. It drops plugin extensibility, so it is worth flagging. clear=false because 'HTTP handlers' reads as covering inline View.as_view() inside path() too, and solutions/, polls/ and account/ urls.py do that without extensions.get. Hesitated with WRONG mixed_group, which would apply if urlpatterns counted as a recurring non-handler kind.
